title.en: Interpretation (Delegations by Minister for Manpower) Order 2024

completenessNote: 全文，共 6 条；逐字取自新加坡法规在线（SSO）官方打印视图，未改写、未节选。附表 2 篇以 900000+ 序号随同收录。

text.en: 1. This Order is the Interpretation (Delegations by Minister for Manpower) Order 2024 and comes into operation on 1 March 2024.

3. The Minister for Manpower, with the Prime Minister’s approval, delegates the functions under the provisions of the Acts specified in the first column of the First Schedule to the persons specified in the third column of the First Schedule, subject to the conditions (if any) specified in the fourth column of the First Schedule.

4. The Minister for Manpower delegates the functions under the provisions of the Acts specified in the first column of the Second Schedule to the persons specified in the third column of the Second Schedule, subject to the conditions (if any) specified in the fourth column of the Second Schedule.
